review_mode: read-only existing archive; no new training or simulator execution
gradient_ratio_formula: wm_window * effective_weight * response_grad_norm / forward_grad_norm; before common clipping/Muon
limitations: Means and sample SD across 5 paired training seeds. Five-condition summary first averages the same five conditions within each seed.
Paired t intervals are exploratory, n=5, not adjusted for multiple outcomes; no equivalence or superiority claim.
Cal response means are equal-session means of within-session block RMSE; 7 sessions/232 blocks per model; raw NPZ omitted so block-level prediction errors not recomputed.
Policy conditions are known actuator endpoints/interpolation and seen training motions, not unseen-motion or hardware validation.
Tracking RMSE uses only valid steps before termination; secondary descriptive metrics may be affected by censoring.
All 16 bins/seed fall back to 8, but zero short bins are validated; fallback must not be described as a calibrated short horizon.
D/C_perm/fixed controls were not launched. No D policy score exists.
Review archive contains no weight tensors: checkpoint and initialization hashes checked for consistency in records only.
